test.prompt: Use only the configured Google Drive tools. Confirm the configured folder {{source}} is readable. Upload one setup-test text file containing {{run_id}}, read it back, then delete only that test file. Report the created file ID, read-back result, and deletion result.
test.expected_output: The configured Drive folder is readable and one reversible upload/read/delete test succeeds.
assertions: The exact configured Drive folder is opened.
One setup-test file containing the run ID is uploaded.
The same file is read back successfully.
Only the created setup-test file is deleted.
